736840101.text: Good day, fellow adventurers! Anyone who's interested in the new event held by the Adventurers' Guild, please gather around!

736840102.text: So long as you participate in the event, you will receive not only rewards offered by the Adventurers' Guild, but also certain extra special gifts!

736840105.text: You are... the Traveler! Oh my, what a pleasant surprise. I wasn't expecting to see you at all!

736840106.text: As you can see, I'm recruiting participants for an event held by the Guild.

736840107.text: This is my first official job in the Guild, and I'm determined to leave a perfect impression!

736840109.text: Ah, you must've not heard about the event!

736840110.text: Jack has named the event "Across the Wilderness."

736840111.text: In his words, this event is gonna be "simple yet fun, and at the same time can test the capabilities of the participating adventurers."

736840112.text: To be more specific, we are going to set up Wilderness Balloons in various locations.

736840113.text: All that the participating adventurers need to do is to find the Wilderness Balloons according to the prompts and venture forward following the distribution of those balloons.

736840114.text: The more Wilderness Balloons one collects within the time limit, the higher the rating and the greater the rewards will be.
